impact.en: Reports of unusual illness or unexplained deaths in the community
impact.sw: Taarifa za magonjwa yasiyo ya kawaida au vifo visivyoelezeka katika jamii

en: Please report unusual illness or sudden deaths to the nearest health facility or community health worker.
Community health workers: report signals through the event-based surveillance system.
District Rapid Response Teams: verify reports within 24 hours.
sw: Tafadhali toeni taarifa ya magonjwa yasiyo ya kawaida au vifo vya ghafla kwenye kituo cha afya kilicho karibu au kwa mhudumu wa afya ngazi ya jamii.
Wahudumu wa afya ngazi ya jamii: toeni taarifa za viashiria kupitia mfumo wa ufuatiliaji wa matukio.
Timu za Wilaya za Kukabiliana na Dharura: thibitisheni taarifa ndani ya saa 24.

impact.en: Outbreak of a priority disease in a neighbouring country
impact.sw: Mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa kipaumbele katika nchi jirani

en: Travellers: please cooperate with health screening at border points.
If you develop fever after travel, please visit a health facility and mention your journey.
Ministry of Health and Port Health: strengthen screening at points of entry.
sw: Wasafiri: tafadhali shirikianeni na uchunguzi wa afya mipakani.
Ukipata homa baada ya safari, tafadhali nenda kituo cha afya na eleza safari yako.
Wizara ya Afya na Afya Mipakani: imarisheni uchunguzi katika vituo vya kuingilia nchini.

impact.en: Unusual deaths or illness in livestock or wildlife
impact.sw: Vifo au magonjwa yasiyo ya kawaida kwa mifugo au wanyamapori

en: Please do not eat, sell or handle meat from animals that died of unknown causes.
Report sick or dead animals to livestock officers.
District Veterinary Officers: investigate and share results with health officers.
sw: Tafadhali msile, msiuze wala kushika nyama ya mifugo iliyokufa kwa sababu zisizojulikana.
Toeni taarifa ya mifugo inayougua au kufa kwa maafisa mifugo.
Maafisa Mifugo wa Wilaya: fanyeni uchunguzi na shirikisheni matokeo na maafisa afya.

impact.en: Rainy-season conditions favouring cholera, malaria and Rift Valley fever
impact.sw: Hali ya msimu wa mvua inayochochea kipindupindu, malaria na homa ya Bonde la Ufa

en: Boil drinking water or treat it with chlorine tablets.
Use latrines, wash hands with soap and sleep under an insecticide-treated net.
Health authorities: pre-position medicines and supplies through MSD.
sw: Chemsheni maji ya kunywa au yatibuni kwa vidonge vya klorini.
Tumieni vyoo, nawini mikono kwa sabuni na laleni ndani ya chandarua chenye dawa.
Mamlaka za afya: wekeni tayari dawa na vifaa kupitia MSD.

impact.en: Rising resistance to antibiotics and other medicines
impact.sw: Kuongezeka kwa usugu wa vimelea dhidi ya dawa

en: Please use antibiotics only when prescribed and complete the full course.
Do not buy antibiotics without a prescription.
Hospitals: strengthen antimicrobial stewardship programmes.
sw: Tafadhali tumieni dawa za antibiotiki kwa maelekezo ya daktari tu na malizeni dozi yote.
Msinunue antibiotiki bila cheti cha daktari.
Hospitali: imarisheni programu za matumizi sahihi ya dawa za antibiotiki.

impact.en: Food safety risks, including aflatoxin in maize and groundnuts
impact.sw: Hatari za usalama wa chakula, ikiwemo sumukuvu kwenye mahindi na karanga

en: Dry maize and groundnuts well and store them off the ground.
Do not eat mouldy grain.
TBS, TMDA and GCLA: test suspected food and investigate food poisoning.
sw: Kausheni vizuri mahindi na karanga na hifadhini juu ya ardhi.
Msile nafaka zenye ukungu.
TBS, TMDA na GCLA: pimeni vyakula vinavyoshukiwa na chunguzeni matukio ya sumu ya chakula.

impact.en: Environmental and chemical health risks
impact.sw: Hatari za kiafya zitokanazo na mazingira na kemikali

en: Please report polluted water sources or chemical smells to Village/Mtaa leaders.
Workers handling chemicals: use protective equipment.
NEMC, OSHA and GCLA: test and investigate reported contamination.
sw: Tafadhali toeni taarifa ya vyanzo vya maji vilivyochafuka au harufu za kemikali kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.
Wafanyakazi wanaoshughulika na kemikali: tumieni vifaa vya kujikinga.
NEMC, OSHA na GCLA: pimeni na chunguzeni uchafuzi ulioripotiwa.

impact.en: Heat and climate-related health risks
impact.sw: Hatari za kiafya zitokanazo na joto na mabadiliko ya tabianchi

en: Drink plenty of safe water and rest in the shade during the hottest hours.
Check on older persons and young children during hot weather.
Health authorities: extend malaria control to newly affected highland areas.
sw: Kunyweni maji safi ya kutosha na pumzikeni kivulini wakati wa joto kali.
Wafuatilieni wazee na watoto wadogo wakati wa joto.
Mamlaka za afya: panueni udhibiti wa malaria kwenye maeneo mapya ya miinuko yaliyoathirika.

impact.en: Higher risk for children under five, older persons, pregnant women and people with chronic illness or disabilities
impact.sw: Hatari kubwa zaidi kwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano, wazee, wajawazito na wenye magonjwa sugu au ulemavu

en: Village/Mtaa and Ward Disaster Management Committees: review health contingency plans and update the list of people with special needs.
Please share this advisory with neighbours and relatives.
sw: Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa za Vijiji/Mitaa na Kata: pitieni mipango ya dharura ya afya na boresheni orodha ya watu wenye mahitaji maalum.
Tafadhali wapatieni taarifa hii majirani na ndugu.

impact.en: Need for community awareness on prevention and early reporting
impact.sw: Uhitaji wa uelewa wa jamii kuhusu kujikinga na kutoa taarifa mapema

en: Religious and community leaders: please share prevention messages at gatherings.
Health authorities: run awareness through radio, markets, mosques and churches.
sw: Viongozi wa dini na jamii: tafadhali sambazeni ujumbe wa kujikinga katika mikusanyiko.
Mamlaka za afya: toeni elimu kupitia redio, masoko, misikiti na makanisa.

impact.en: Need to pre-position medicines, protective equipment and vaccines
impact.sw: Uhitaji wa kuweka tayari dawa, vifaa vya kujikinga na chanjo

en: Health facilities: check stocks of essential medicines, vaccines and protective equipment.
MSD: support supply and maintain the vaccine cold chain.
sw: Vituo vya afya: kagueni akiba ya dawa muhimu, chanjo na vifaa vya kujikinga.
MSD: saidieni usambazaji na tunzeni mnyororo baridi wa chanjo.

impact.en: Need for One Health coordination across sectors
impact.sw: Uhitaji wa uratibu wa Afya Moja kati ya sekta

en: Prime Minister's Office – One Health Section: convene coordination meetings of the health, livestock, wildlife, environment and agriculture sectors.
District Committees: include health and livestock officers in all preparedness meetings.
sw: Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu – Dawati la Afya Moja: itisheni vikao vya uratibu vya sekta za afya, mifugo, wanyamapori, mazingira na kilimo.
Kamati za Wilaya: shirikisheni maafisa afya na mifugo katika vikao vyote vya maandalizi.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please continue to follow updates from the Ministry of Health, health workers and Disaster Management Committees.
This advisory remains in place until the authorities update or withdraw it.
sw: Tafadhali endeleeni kufuatilia taarifa za Wizara ya Afya, watoa huduma za afya na Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa.
Tahadhari hii itaendelea hadi mamlaka zitakapoihuisha au kuiondoa rasmi.

impact.en: Confirmed cases of an epidemic-prone disease (e.g. cholera, anthrax, Rift Valley fever) in one or more districts
impact.sw: Wagonjwa waliothibitishwa wa ugonjwa wa mlipuko (mfano kipindupindu, kimeta, homa ya Bonde la Ufa) katika wilaya moja au zaidi

en: Please follow prevention advice from health workers and Village/Mtaa leaders.
Ministry of Health and District Health Management Teams: activate outbreak response and deploy Rapid Response Teams.
District Disaster Management Committees: meet and support the health response.
sw: Tafadhali fuateni ushauri wa kujikinga kutoka kwa watoa huduma za afya na viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.
Wizara ya Afya na Timu za Uendeshaji wa Huduma za Afya za Wilaya: amilisheni mwitikio wa mlipuko na pelekeni Timu za Kukabiliana na Dharura.
Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa za Wilaya: kutaneni na saidieni mwitikio wa afya.

impact.en: Health workers at risk of infection
impact.sw: Watoa huduma za afya kuwa hatarini kuambukizwa

en: Health facilities: provide protective equipment and train staff in infection prevention and control.
Set up screening and isolation areas at health facilities.
sw: Vituo vya afya: toeni vifaa vya kujikinga na fundisheni watumishi kuhusu kuzuia na kudhibiti maambukizi.
Anzisheni maeneo ya uchunguzi na utengaji katika vituo vya afya.

impact.en: Contacts of cases need to be followed up
impact.sw: Watu waliokutana na wagonjwa kuhitaji kufuatiliwa

en: If a health worker contacts you, please cooperate and report any symptoms.
Contact-tracing teams: follow up contacts daily for the incubation period.
Village/Mtaa leaders: support contact tracing in the community.
sw: Mtoa huduma za afya akiwasiliana nawe, tafadhali shirikiana naye na toa taarifa ya dalili zozote.
Timu za ufuatiliaji: fuatilieni waliokutana na wagonjwa kila siku kwa kipindi cha kuatamia ugonjwa.
Viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa: saidieni ufuatiliaji katika jamii.

impact.en: Hospital outbreak of drug-resistant infections
impact.sw: Mlipuko wa maambukizi sugu ya dawa hospitalini

en: Hospital infection prevention committees: isolate affected patients and investigate.
Report to the national antimicrobial resistance coordinating committee.
sw: Kamati za hospitali za kuzuia maambukizi: tengeni wagonjwa walioathirika na fanyeni uchunguzi.
Toeni taarifa kwa kamati ya kitaifa ya uratibu wa usugu wa vimelea dhidi ya dawa.

impact.en: Confirmed food poisoning or aflatoxin outbreak
impact.sw: Mlipuko uliothibitishwa wa sumu ya chakula au sumukuvu

en: Please stop eating the suspected food and take sick people to a health facility.
TBS, TMDA and GCLA: trace the source and remove affected products from markets.
sw: Tafadhali acheni kula chakula kinachoshukiwa na wapelekeni wagonjwa kituo cha afya.
TBS, TMDA na GCLA: fuatilieni chanzo na ondoeni bidhaa zilizoathirika sokoni.

impact.en: Environmental or chemical exposure event
impact.sw: Tukio la kuathiriwa na mazingira au kemikali

en: Residents near the affected site: please follow instructions to move away.
Exposed people: go to a health facility.
NEMC, OSHA and GCLA: contain the source and investigate.
sw: Wakazi walio karibu na eneo lililoathirika: tafadhali fuateni maelekezo ya kuondoka.
Walioathirika: nendeni kituo cha afya.
NEMC, OSHA na GCLA: dhibitini chanzo na fanyeni uchunguzi.

impact.en: Risk of spread across borders and between districts
impact.sw: Hatari ya ugonjwa kusambaa mipakani na kati ya wilaya

en: Travellers: please cooperate with screening and avoid non-essential travel to affected areas.
Ministry of Health: coordinate with neighbouring countries and notify WHO as required by the International Health Regulations.
sw: Wasafiri: tafadhali shirikianeni na uchunguzi na epukeni safari zisizo za lazima kwenda maeneo yaliyoathirika.
Wizara ya Afya: ratibuni na nchi jirani na toeni taarifa WHO kama inavyotakiwa na Kanuni za Afya za Kimataifa.

impact.en: Disease linked to animals
impact.sw: Ugonjwa unaohusiana na wanyama

en: Livestock keepers: please vaccinate animals and follow livestock movement restrictions.
Do not slaughter or eat sick or dead animals.
Ministry responsible for livestock, TVLA, TANAPA and TAWA: control the disease in animals.
sw: Wafugaji: tafadhali chanjeni mifugo na fuateni vizuizi vya kusafirisha mifugo.
Msichinje wala kula mifugo inayougua au iliyokufa.
Wizara yenye dhamana ya mifugo, TVLA, TANAPA na TAWA: dhibitini ugonjwa kwa wanyama.

impact.en: Need for treatment and isolation capacity
impact.sw: Uhitaji wa uwezo wa matibabu na utengaji

en: Designated hospitals: prepare isolation and treatment units.
Refer severe cases to referral hospitals.
sw: Hospitali teule: andaeni vituo vya utengaji na matibabu.
Wapelekeni wagonjwa mahututi hospitali za rufaa.

impact.en: Rumours, misinformation and stigma
impact.sw: Uvumi, taarifa potofu na unyanyapaa

en: Please rely only on information from the Ministry of Health and health workers.
Please support affected families and do not stigmatise them.
Religious and community leaders: share correct health messages.
sw: Tafadhali tegemeeni taarifa za Wizara ya Afya na watoa huduma za afya pekee.
Tafadhali wasaidieni familia zilizoathirika na msiwanyanyapae.
Viongozi wa dini na jamii: sambazeni ujumbe sahihi wa afya.

impact.en: Need for safe burial of people who died of high-risk diseases
impact.sw: Uhitaji wa maziko salama kwa waliofariki kwa magonjwa hatarishi

en: Families: please do not wash or touch the body; inform health workers.
Trained burial teams: conduct safe and dignified burials together with religious leaders.
sw: Familia: tafadhali msiuoshe wala kuugusa mwili; wajulisheni watoa huduma za afya.
Timu za maziko zilizofunzwa: fanyeni maziko salama na ya heshima kwa kushirikiana na viongozi wa dini.

impact.en: Need for rapid laboratory confirmation
impact.sw: Uhitaji wa uthibitisho wa haraka wa maabara

en: Health facilities: send samples to designated reference laboratories using safe transport.
Laboratories: share results within 24–48 hours.
sw: Vituo vya afya: pelekeni sampuli maabara teule za rufaa kwa usafirishaji salama.
Maabara: toeni majibu ndani ya saa 24–48.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please continue to follow updates from the Ministry of Health, health workers and Disaster Management Committees.
This warning remains in force until the Ministry of Health lowers or withdraws it.
sw: Tafadhali endeleeni kufuatilia taarifa za Wizara ya Afya, watoa huduma za afya na Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa.
Tahadhari hii itaendelea kutumika hadi Wizara ya Afya itakapoishusha au kuiondoa rasmi.

impact.en: Widespread transmission of a high-consequence disease across several districts or regions
impact.sw: Maambukizi yaliyoenea ya ugonjwa hatari katika wilaya au mikoa kadhaa

en: Please follow all public health directives from the Ministry of Health and Disaster Management Committees.
Ministry of Health and the Prime Minister's Office – Disaster Management Department: coordinate the national response and advise the Government on emergency measures.
Regional and District Committees: activate health emergency contingency plans.
sw: Tafadhali fuateni maelekezo yote ya afya ya jamii kutoka Wizara ya Afya na Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa.
Wizara ya Afya na Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu – Idara ya Menejimenti ya Maafa: ratibuni mwitikio wa kitaifa na toeni ushauri kwa Serikali kuhusu hatua za dharura.
Kamati za Mikoa na Wilaya: amilisheni mipango ya dharura ya afya.

impact.en: Any confirmed case of Ebola or Marburg, or a disease spreading rapidly with high deaths
impact.sw: Mgonjwa yeyote aliyethibitishwa wa Ebola au Marburg, au ugonjwa unaosambaa kwa kasi na vifo vingi

en: If you or someone near you has fever with bleeding, vomiting or diarrhoea, please call 190 or inform health workers immediately; do not travel.
Ministry of Health: isolate cases, trace all contacts and deploy specialist medical teams.
Request technical support from WHO as needed.
sw: Ukiwa wewe au mtu wa karibu ana homa pamoja na kutokwa damu, kutapika au kuhara, tafadhali piga 190 au wajulishe watoa huduma za afya mara moja; usisafiri.
Wizara ya Afya: tengeni wagonjwa, fuatilieni wote waliokutana nao na pelekeni timu za wataalamu wa tiba.
Ombeni msaada wa kitaalamu kutoka WHO inapohitajika.

impact.en: Health facilities overwhelmed by large numbers of patients
impact.sw: Vituo vya afya kuzidiwa na idadi kubwa ya wagonjwa

en: Please go to the facility you are directed to and follow instructions from health workers.
Hospitals: activate surge plans and set up dedicated treatment units.
Request JWTZ medical support through the Prime Minister's Office where needed.
sw: Tafadhali nendeni kituo mnachoelekezwa na fuateni maelekezo ya watoa huduma za afya.
Hospitali: amilisheni mipango ya kuongeza uwezo na anzisheni vituo maalum vya matibabu.
Ombeni msaada wa kitabibu wa JWTZ kupitia Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu inapohitajika.

impact.en: Mass-casualty event requiring emergency trauma care
impact.sw: Tukio la majeruhi wengi linalohitaji huduma za dharura za majeraha

en: Please keep roads to hospitals clear and avoid crowding at the scene.
Hospitals: activate mass-casualty plans and triage.
Fire and Rescue Force, the Police Force and the Red Cross: support rescue and emergency transport.
sw: Tafadhali achieni wazi barabara za kwenda hospitali na epukeni kujazana eneo la tukio.
Hospitali: amilisheni mipango ya kupokea majeruhi wengi na upangaji wa wagonjwa kwa kipaumbele.
Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji, Jeshi la Polisi na Chama cha Msalaba Mwekundu: saidieni uokoaji na usafiri wa dharura.

impact.en: Many deaths requiring safe and dignified burial
impact.sw: Vifo vingi vinavyohitaji maziko salama na ya heshima

en: Families: please follow burial guidance from health workers.
Trained burial teams: conduct safe and dignified burials with religious leaders.
District Committees: provide psychosocial support to bereaved families.
sw: Familia: tafadhali fuateni maelekezo ya maziko kutoka kwa watoa huduma za afya.
Timu za maziko zilizofunzwa: fanyeni maziko salama na ya heshima kwa kushirikiana na viongozi wa dini.
Kamati za Wilaya: toeni msaada wa kisaikolojia kwa familia zilizofiwa.

impact.en: Event of international concern
impact.sw: Tukio lenye umuhimu wa kimataifa

en: Ministry of Health (IHR National Focal Point): notify WHO within 24 hours and share regular situation reports.
Coordinate with the East African Community, SADC and Africa CDC.
sw: Wizara ya Afya (Kituo cha Kitaifa cha IHR): toeni taarifa WHO ndani ya saa 24 na shirikisheni taarifa za hali mara kwa mara.
Ratibuni na Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki, SADC na Africa CDC.

impact.en: Severe malnutrition among children
impact.sw: Utapiamlo mkali kwa watoto

en: Parents: please take thin or weak children to the nearest health facility.
Continue breastfeeding infants.
Health workers: screen and treat children with severe malnutrition.
sw: Wazazi: tafadhali wapelekeni watoto waliokonda au dhaifu kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Endeleeni kunyonyesha watoto wachanga.
Watoa huduma za afya: fanyeni uchunguzi na tibuni watoto wenye utapiamlo mkali.

impact.en: Risks to mothers and newborns during the emergency
impact.sw: Hatari kwa akina mama na watoto wachanga wakati wa dharura

en: Pregnant women: please continue antenatal visits and deliver at a health facility.
Health facilities: keep emergency obstetric and newborn care running.
sw: Wajawazito: tafadhali endeleeni na kliniki na mjifungulie kituo cha afya.
Vituo vya afya: endelezeni huduma za dharura za uzazi na watoto wachanga.

impact.en: Distress among survivors, bereaved families and health workers
impact.sw: Msongo wa mawazo kwa manusura, familia zilizofiwa na watoa huduma za afya

en: Please support neighbours who have lost family members.
Ministry responsible for social welfare and the Red Cross: provide psychosocial support.
sw: Tafadhali wasaidieni majirani waliopoteza wanafamilia.
Wizara yenye dhamana ya ustawi wa jamii na Chama cha Msalaba Mwekundu: toeni msaada wa kisaikolojia.

impact.en: Disruption to schools, markets, transport and routine health services
impact.sw: Usumbufu wa shule, masoko, usafiri na huduma za kawaida za afya

en: Please follow directives on schools, markets and gatherings.
Health facilities: maintain immunisation, HIV, TB and chronic-disease services.
MSD: protect supplies of medicines and vaccines.
sw: Tafadhali fuateni maelekezo kuhusu shule, masoko na mikusanyiko.
Vituo vya afya: endelezeni huduma za chanjo, VVU, kifua kikuu na magonjwa sugu.
MSD: lindeni upatikanaji wa dawa na chanjo.

impact.en: Need to protect communities with water, sanitation and hygiene
impact.sw: Uhitaji wa kulinda jamii kwa maji safi, usafi wa mazingira na usafi binafsi

en: Drink only boiled or treated water and wash hands with soap.
District Committees: supply safe water and hygiene materials to affected communities.
sw: Kunyweni maji yaliyochemshwa au kutibiwa tu na nawini mikono kwa sabuni.
Kamati za Wilaya: sambazeni maji safi na vifaa vya usafi kwa jamii zilizoathirika.

impact.en: National and international support required
impact.sw: Msaada wa kitaifa na kimataifa unahitajika

en: Prime Minister's Office – Disaster Management Department and One Health Section: coordinate national resources.
Engage partners such as WHO, FAO, WOAH, Africa CDC, UNICEF and the Red Cross as needed.
sw: Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu – Idara ya Menejimenti ya Maafa na Dawati la Afya Moja: ratibuni rasilimali za kitaifa.
Shirikisheni wadau kama WHO, FAO, WOAH, Africa CDC, UNICEF na Chama cha Msalaba Mwekundu inapohitajika.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please rely on official sources: the Ministry of Health, radio, Disaster Management Committees and local leaders.
The Ministry of Health will announce when the outbreak has ended.
sw: Tafadhali tegemeeni taarifa rasmi: Wizara ya Afya, redio, Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa na viongozi wa eneo.
Wizara ya Afya itatangaza mlipuko utakapomalizika.
